প্রশ্ন প্রণয়নে:
জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English Wizard.question: ১) The work has been done sincerely by them for five years. (Make it Active)
English Wizard.option1: ক) They have done the work sincerely for five years.
English Wizard.option2: খ) They have doing the work sincerely for five years.
English Wizard.option3: গ) They has been doing the work sincerely for five years.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) They have been doing the work sincerely for five years.
English Wizard.exp: Passive Voice এ Perfect Tense (have + been + Verb এর Past participle) এর গঠন থাকলেও যদি বাক্যের মধ্যে Point of Time বা Period of Time (এখানে for five years) উল্লেখ করা থাকে, তাহলে Active Voice এ বাক্যটাকে Perfect Continuous Tense (have + been + verb+ing) বানিয়ে বসাতে হবে।

English Wizard.question: ২) Did he answer the questions? (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Did the questions be answered by him?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Was the questions answered by him?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Were the questions answered by him?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Did the questions were answered by him?
English Wizard.exp: Active Voice এ ‘did’ থাকলে passive voice এ এর পরিবর্তে was/were বসে। Subject – Plural হওয়ায় were বসবে। তারপর Object – Subject হয়ে বসবে। তারপর মূল Verb এর Past Participle. এর পর by + Subject এর Objective Form.

English Wizard.question: ৩) He encouraged us to study relentlessly. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) We are encouraged to study relentlessly by him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We were encouraged to study relentlessly by him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) We have encouraged to study relentlessly by him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) We encouraged to be studied relentlessly by him.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যটা Past Indefinite Tense.
অতএব, Passive Structure হবে
Subjective form of Object + was/were + Past Participle of the main verb + by + objective form of Subject
Object এর পর Infinitive থাকলে এবং এটা যদি object এর সাথেই related হয়, তাহলে এটাকে by + objective form of Subject এর পূর্বে বসাতে হয়।

English Wizard.question: ৪) I could not repair the machine. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The machine could not repaired by me.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The machine could not have repaired by me.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The machine could not be repairing by me.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The machine could not be repaired by me.
English Wizard.exp:
Modal Auxiliary Verb যুক্ত বাক্যকে Passive করার Structure হচ্ছে –
Subjective form of Object + modal auxiliary বসবে + be + Past Participle of Main Verb + by + Objective Form of Subject

English Wizard.question: ৫) They are going to establish a hospital there. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) A hospital is being gone to establish there by them.
English Wizard.option2: খ) A hospital is being gone to be established there by them.
English Wizard.option3: গ) A hospital is going to be established there by them.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) A hospital is going to established there by them.
English Wizard.exp:
এখানে are going to – Modal Auxiliary হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।
Modal Auxiliary Verb যুক্ত বাক্যকে Passive করার Structure হচ্ছে –
Object Subject হবে + modal auxiliary বসবে + be + Past Participle of Main Verb + by + Subject এর Objective Form.

English Wizard.question: ৬) Tanim was not supported by his family members. (Make it Active)
English Wizard.option1: ক) His family members were not supporting Tanim.
English Wizard.option2: খ) His family members did not support Tanim.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Tanim’s family members did not support him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Tanim’s family members did not supported him.
English Wizard.exp:
নিয়ম অনুযায়ী Noun আগে বসে, তারপর তার Pronoun. এ হিসেবে Passive Voice এ Object কে Subject বানিয়ে বসানোর সময় Object এর মধ্যে যে his আছে তাকে পরিবর্তন করে Tanim’s লিখতে হবে। নতুবা his দ্বারা Tanim কে না বুঝিয়ে অন্য কাউকে বুঝাবে।
Negative বাক্যে was/were এর পরিবর্তে did বসাতে হয় এবং মূল verb এর base form বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৭) John hasn’t invited me on the occasion. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I hasn’t been invited on the occasion by John.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I wasn’t invited on the occasion by John.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I haven’t invited by John on the occasion.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I haven’t been invited by John on the occasion.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যটি Present Perfect Tense.
এর Passive Structure হচ্ছে –
Subjective form of Object + have/has + been + Past Participle of the main verb + by + Objective form of Subject

English Wizard.question: ৮) Let him not break the rule. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Let not the rule be break by him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Let the rule not broken by him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let not the rule be broken by him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let not the rule be broke by him.
English Wizard.exp:
প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি Imperative sentence. Let যুক্ত Imperative sentence এর passive voice এর গঠন :
Let + objective form of object (used as subject) + be + past participle + by + objective form of subject

English Wizard.question: ৯) I saw him working hard. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He was seen working hard by me.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He was seen being worked hard by me.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I saw him being worked hard.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I saw being worked hard by him.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যটা Past Indefinite Tense.
অতএব, Passive Structure হবে
Subjective form of object + was/were + Past Participle of the main verb + by + objective form of subject.
Object এর পর Participle Phrase (verb+ing + Extension) থাকলে এবং এটা যদি object এর সাথেই related হয়, তাহলে এটাকে by+obj এর পূর্বে বসাতে হয়।

English Wizard.question: ১০) Publish the book. (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option2: খ) Let the book be published.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Let the book being published.
English Wizard.exp:
প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি Imperative sentence.
Imperative sentence এর passive voice এর গঠন :
Let + object + be + past participle.

English Wizard.question: ১১) Who doesn’t know him? (Make it Passive)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Who is not known to him?
English Wizard.option2: খ) By whom isn’t he known?
English Wizard.option3: গ) To whom he isn’t known?
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) To whom isn’t he known?
English Wizard.exp:
Who যুক্ত এ ধরনের বাক্যকে passive voice এ রূপান্তর করার structure হলো-
By whom + be verb + obj এর subjective form + v3 + ?
কিন্তু এখানে মূল Verb – know আছে। know থাকলে by whom না বসে to whom বসবে। অতএব, সঠিক উত্তর (ঘ)।

English Wizard.question: ১২) The poor were being deprived of their rights by the king. (Make it Active)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The king were depriving the poor of their rights.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The king was depriving of the poor their rights.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The king was depriving the poor of their rights.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The king was deprived the poor of their rights.
English Wizard.exp: Passive Voice এ being + Past Participle of the verb থাকলে active voice এ being বাদ যায় এবং মূল Verb এর শেষে ing যোগ হয়।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) There is no rose but has a thorn. What type of part of speech is but?
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ- এমন কোনো গোলাপ নেই যার কাটা নেই।
but (যার নেই) দ্বারা এখানে তার পূর্বের noun- rose কে বুঝাচ্ছে। যা Noun এর পরিবর্তে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তা Pronoun হয়ে থাকে। অতএব, but এখানে Pronoun.

English Wizard.question: ১৪) He has not yet come. Here ‘Yet’ is a/an –
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ- সে এখনো আসে নি।
yet= এখনো।
yet এখানে verb সংগঠিত (না) হওয়ার সময় বুঝাচ্ছে। তাই এটা Adverb of Time.

English Wizard.question: ১৫) He was left <u>all</u> alone on the vast sea. Here the underlined word is a/an –
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ- বিশাল সমুদ্রের মধ্যে সে একেবারে একা পড়ে রয়েছিল।
এখানে all অর্থ ‘একেবারে’ যা alone (adverb) কে modify করছে।
Adverb কে যা modify করে, তাও adverb.

English Wizard.question: ১৬) <u>More</u> of us die in bed than out of it. Here the underlined word is a/an –
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ- আমাদের অধিকাংশই বিছানার বাইরের চেয়ে বিছানায়ই মারা যায় বেশি।
এখানে more শব্দটা এককভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে, কাউকে Modify করতে আসে নি এবং বাক্যে Subject হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে। তাই এটা এখানে Pronoun.

English Wizard.question: ১৭) <u>Once</u> I find him who has conspired, I must punish him. Here the underlined word is a/an–
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ- যে ষড়যন্ত্র করেছে, তাকে যদি একবার পাই, তাহলে আমি তাকে অবশ্যই শাস্তি দিব।
এখানে once = if once (একবার যদি)।
once এখানে I find him এবং I must punish him দুটি Clause কে সংযুক্ত করেছে। তাই এটি এখানে Conjunction.

English Wizard.question: ১৮) We should, according to necessity, <u>even</u> the ground. Here the underlined word is a/an –
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ – প্রয়োজন অনুযায়ী আমাদের মাঠকে/প্রেক্ষাপটকে সমান করতে হবে।
এখান even – সমান করা- অর্থে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে। তাই এটি এখানে verb.

English Wizard.question: ১৯) Is that <u>any</u> better? Here the underlined word is a/an –
English Wizard.exp:
any এখানে better (adjective) কে Modify করছে। adjective কে যা modify করে তা Adverb হয়। অতএব, any এখানে adverb.
বাক্যের অর্থ- ওটা কি কোনোভাবে ভালো?

English Wizard.question: ২০) The noun form of ‘abundant’ is -
English Wizard.exp: abundant এর noun form হচ্ছে abundance.

English Wizard.question: ২১) The noun form of ‘bankrupt’ is–
English Wizard.exp: bankrupt (দেউলিয়া) এর noun form হচ্ছে bankruptcy (দেউলিয়াত্ব).

English Wizard.question: ২২) The noun form of ‘sure’ is-
English Wizard.exp: sure এর noun হচ্ছে surety (নিশ্চয়তা).

English Wizard.question: ২৩) The adjective form of ‘book’ is –
English Wizard.exp: book এর Adjective হচ্ছে bookish.

English Wizard.question: ২৪) The adjective form of ‘spontaneity’ is–
English Wizard.exp: spontaneity = স্বতঃস্ফূর্ততা। এর Adjective Form হচ্ছে spontaneous = স্বতঃস্ফূর্ত.

English Wizard.question: ২৫) The adjective form of ‘grammar’ is–
English Wizard.exp: Grammar এর Adjective Form হচ্ছে Grammatical. এখানে r টা বাদ পড়ে যায়।
